response.summary: The candidates identify the substantial weight gain omission; the husband’s corroboration is downgraded because episode frequency is already represented. Additional material omissions include first-episode chronology, panic/avoidance duration and context, onset of nighttime eating during the earlier therapy, and course details. The projection’s ethnicity lead cannot be mapped to an existing patient-information leaf.
